contact_study.name: Contact / two bodies, four ways to meet
contact_study.description: Two standing bodies come together as the visitor comes near, made four ways: THROUGH (two meshes pass through each other), CUT (a boolean difference), CUBES (the join in 5 cm cells), SKIN (a smooth union: a neck grows between the two before they touch, then a second join leaves an opening). Baked frames; the visitor's distance chooses the frame. strategy = all | through | cut | cubes | skin.
